title: Restore a save snapshot
summary: Put your game home back the way it was at an earlier save, and keep the save you replace in case you change your mind.
for: Anyone playing in the HumanityOS desktop app whose home went wrong: a bad trade, something lost, a save spoiled by a bug.

steps.text: Find Save snapshots, and under it the save you want to put back. The one the game is using is called Your home, with its slot name after it.
detail: Before the game saves over your home it keeps a copy of the save it replaces: the newest 10 copies, at most one every 15 minutes. The game saves every 2 minutes while you play, and when you quit.

Restore soon after something goes wrong: as you keep playing, older copies are replaced. The ten, at least 15 minutes apart, reach back about two and a quarter hours of play, and less if you pressed Snapshot now or restored, since each of those keeps a copy too.

steps.text: Find the copy from the time you want, by its date and time, how long ago it was, and its size, and press Restore beside it.
It says your current save is kept as a snapshot first. Is this the copy you want? If not, press Cancel.
Does the line under the list begin with Restored?
If it says a restored save is waiting, enter the world: the restored home loads then.
detail: Until you enter the world the game does not save over the restored copy.

worked_if: Your home is as it was when the copy you picked was taken.

problems.why: The first copy is kept the next time the game saves over your home.
problems.fix: There is nothing to restore yet. For next time, play until the game saves, or press Snapshot now to keep a copy of your home as it was last saved.

problems.sign: The line under the list begins with Nothing was changed.
problems.why: The copy could not be put back; the rest of the line says why.
problems.fix: Your save is as it was before. Read the reason, and report a bug if it does not make sense.

problems.why: A restore keeps the save it replaces among the snapshots.
problems.fix: Restore again, picking the copy the first restore kept: a restore can be undone.

problems.sign: It says only your character is loaded now.
problems.why: Start every session from the default home is on (Settings, Gameplay).
problems.fix: Turn it off, and the restored home is the one you play.

sources.title: Settings, Data: Save snapshots
sources.quote: Restore puts a copy back and keeps the save it replaces among the snapshots, so a restore can be undone.
sources.note: The desktop app's own code (draw_save_snapshots), as it stood on 2026-10-23 (commit 1638661e8): its explanation, Your home, Restore, Yes, restore and Cancel, Your current save is kept as a snapshot first, Snapshot now, No snapshots yet, A restored save is waiting, and a failure beginning Nothing was changed. Game saves are on the desktop only.

sources.title: Save snapshots: how many are kept and how often
sources.note: SNAPSHOTS_KEPT is 10 and SNAPSHOT_SPACING_SECS is 15 minutes; the home is saved every two minutes while you play. As the code stood on 2026-10-23.

sources.title: restore_snapshot_into_game: what a restore says
sources.note: Its lines begin Restored (on disk, or with the home being loaded back into the game); with Start every session from the default home on, only the character is loaded now. As the code stood on 2026-10-23.
